description: SendHardwareInfo: hardware is stored once per hash (of the XML with memory, cpuid1_* and userID zeroed) and linked to the account; a CPU that is neither Intel nor AMD logs the account out.

steps.note: Registration logs in too: launcher token ...0001.
An Intel machine: a new hardware row, and its hash on the account.
The same machine with other memory and user id: the same hash, so the row's user is updated.
An AMD machine with another GPU: a second row.
